literal: Wealth accumulated by theft, exceeding measure, appearing to grow like, will perish.
translation: Wealth accumulated by theft may seem to grow beyond measure, but it will perish utterly.
modern: களவினால் சேர்க்கப்பட்ட செல்வம், எல்லை கடந்து பெருகுவது போலத் தோன்றி, இறுதியில் அழியும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against the illusion of wealth acquired through dishonest means or theft. The poet explains that although stolen wealth (களவினால் ஆகிய ஆக்கம்) might appear to grow rapidly and exceed all limits (அளவிறந்து ஆவது போல), this growth is merely a deceptive illusion. In reality, such ill-gotten gains will vanish completely (கெடும்), leaving nothing behind. The key contrast is between the appearance of prosperity and its inevitable, sudden ruin.
